name: Maon
title: Father of Beth-shur in the line of Judah
summary: Maon was a link in the tribe of Judah, mentioned as the father of (the founder of) Beth-shur in the lineage of Caleb.

keyEvents.title: Mentioned in the genealogy of Judah
keyEvents.description: Maon is listed in the genealogy of Judah as the father of Beth-shur.
